notes.note: Reviewed the isolated active-work contract against MCP dispatch and the grant-derived reader. The deployed endpoint stays guarded. Stable Project identity, inventory visibility, direct Session scope and durable host history are checked across the lineage before projection. The application scans a bounded number of visible candidate IDs; the SQLite query itself has no storage scan bound. Signed cursors bind the grant and scope.
Reviewed existing Station Control and person-facing work discovery. Their caller authority, query values, row projection, ordering, and cursor format are preserved through the shared activity reader.
Scoped review of the new active-work wire case. The original R4a receipts still describe the two-tool composition and their original fault controls.

Reviewed optional active-work composition. Request authentication, stream emission admission, transport capacity and the compiled release guard retain the same ownership.
